name: svg-elements
prompt: Add support for tag.fe_gaussian_blur and tag.fe_component_transfer in ActionView, using SVG's feGaussianBlur and feComponentTransfer spelling. They should follow the existing SVG element behavior for empty calls, content, blocks, attributes, and escaping. Preserve existing HTML and custom-element behavior. Before changing production code, add and run focused characterization tests against the current implementation for representative existing tags; then implement the new support and verify it. Keep the change bounded. Report exactly what was verified and any unmet verification requirement. The component test command is documented in EVAL_ENVIRONMENT.md.
expected: Extends existing element registration and the established tests without a replacement tag pipeline. Characterization runs before production edits; new behavior and unaffected HTML/escaping behavior pass independently executed checks.

criteria.text: The held-back checks pass for both new elements, no-content/content/block calls, escaping, and unchanged HTML/custom-element behavior.
Production changes reuse the existing SVG element-generation owner without a new configurable registry, wrapper, or replacement dispatch architecture.
The tool trace shows newly added characterization tests running successfully before production edits, and verification after the change; a final claim alone is insufficient.
Tests distinguish the new elements' behavior and escaping without one opaque aggregate assertion or redundant broad scenarios.
The final report matches executed checks and delivery state.
Independent review is performed when available or explicitly reported as unmet; self-review is not called independent review.

checks.description: Held-back checks for the two new SVG elements and unchanged HTML/custom elements
Upstream ActionView tag helper tests, including any the agent added

historyPattern: Extend a fixed existing pipeline without configurability; establish characterization evidence before changing production behavior.
versionNotes: v2 rebuilds the held-back check and the Rails component runtime; the v1 check file and runtime were not retained.
v2 splits the v1 report criterion: report accuracy is a task criterion; independent-review disclosure is a skill process criterion the shared prompt does not request.
